familyLine: Six small apps from Longline Labs, each built to work the same way.

apps.name: Coifish
apps.description: Certificates of insurance for every vendor at every association, current and on file.

apps.name: ReelMinder
apps.description: Reminders for every association deadline, from insurance renewals to annual meeting notices.

apps.name: PacketSkipper
apps.description: Board packets, minutes, action items, all in one place.

apps.name: BallastBook
apps.description: A simple annual budget builder for each of your associations.

apps.name: ShipShape
apps.description: Renames every file to your company's own naming convention, so documents are always easy to find.

apps.name: AboveBoard
apps.description: One public page for each association's governing documents, minutes, and records.
